--worker-create-home-dir.description: Create a temporary home directory for worker pods. Defaults to true when --worker-run-as-uid is set, false otherwise.

--worker-env-pod-field-ref.description: Set an environment variable from a pod field reference for worker pods. Format: ENV_VARIABLE=FIELD_REFERENCE.

--worker-env-secret.description: Set an environment variable from a Kubernetes secret for worker pods. Format: ENV_VARIABLE=secret-name,key=secret-key.

--worker-environment.description: Set environment variables in worker pods. Format: --worker-environment name=value --worker-environment name-b=value-b.

--worker-image.description: The container image to use for worker pods.

--worker-image-pull-policy.description: Image pull policy for worker pods. Valid values: Always, IfNotPresent, Never.

--worker-working-dir.description: Working directory inside worker pods. Overrides the default working directory set in the image.

--working-dir.description: Working directory inside the container. Overrides the default working directory set in the image.

--cpu-core-limit.description: Maximum number of CPU cores allowed (e.g. 0.5, 1).

--cpu-core-request.description: Number of CPU cores to request (e.g. 0.5, 1).

--extended-resource.description: Request access to a Kubernetes extended resource. Format: resource_name=quantity.

--gpu-devices-request.description: Number of GPU devices to allocate for the workload (e.g. 1, 2).

--gpu-memory-request.description: Amount of GPU memory to allocate (e.g. 1G, 500M).

--gpu-portion-limit.description: Maximum GPU fraction allowed for the workload (between 0 and 1).

--gpu-portion-request.description: Fraction of a GPU to allocate (between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.5).

--gpu-request-type.description: Type of GPU request: portion, memory

--large-shm.description: Request a large /dev/shm device to mount in the container. Useful for memory-intensive workloads.

--worker-cpu-core-limit.description: Maximum number of CPU cores allowed per worker pod (e.g. 0.5, 1).

--worker-cpu-core-request.description: Number of CPU cores to request per worker pod (e.g. 0.5, 1).

--worker-gpu-memory-request.description: Amount of GPU memory to allocate per worker pod (e.g. 1G, 500M).

--worker-gpu-portion-limit.description: Maximum GPU fraction allowed per worker pod (between 0 and 1).

--worker-gpu-portion-request.description: Fraction of a GPU to allocate per worker pod (between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.5).

--empty-dir-volume.description: Mount an empty directory as a volume. Format: name=NAME,path=PATH,medium=MEDIUM,size-limit=SIZE.

--existing-pvc.description: Mount an existing PersistentVolumeClaim. Format: claimname=CLAIM_NAME,path=PATH. Auto-complete supported.

--new-pvc.description: Create and mount a new volume. This volume is used only for the duration of the workload's lifecycle. Format: claimname=CLAIM_NAME,storageclass=STORAGE_CLASS,size=SIZE,path=PATH,accessmode-rwo,accessmode-rom,accessmode-rwm,ro,ephemeral.

--secret-volume.description: Mount a Kubernetes Secret as a volume. Format: path=PATH,name=SECRET_RESOURCE_NAME.

--preemptibility.description: Specify whether the workload can be preempted by higher-priority workloads. Valid values: preemptible, semi-preemptible, non-preemptible. Overrides the default preemptibility for the workload type.

--restart-policy.description: Restart policy for distributed inference workload. Valid values: RecreateGroupOnPodRestart (restarts all pods if any pod fails), None (no automatic restart). Defaults to RecreateGroupOnPodRestart

--termination-grace-period.description: The length of time (like 5s or 2m, higher than zero) the workload's pod is expected to terminate gracefully upon probe failure. In case value is not specified, kubernetes default of 30 seconds applies (default 0s)

--capability.description: Add POSIX capabilities to the container. Defaults to the runtime's default set.

--host-network.description: Enable host networking for the container. Default: false.
